# Dua mobile design preview

Open `/preview/` on the deployed web site, or serve this directory with a static HTTP server. Start at `index.html`.

This directory preserves the interactive design work separately from the production Gemini chat. Replies, Voice states and gallery states are simulations. Voice does not record audio; attachments retain metadata only and are not uploaded. Coming-soon features remain unavailable.

Includes 27 screens, navigation, draft/session restoration, composer Send/Stop behavior, mobile keyboard layout, Settings pages, chat state gallery, and the Voice cube with 3D rotation, soft pulse and reduced-motion support.

`dua-logo.svg` embeds the supplied raster logo for portable delivery; it is not editable vector branding. Android application files are unchanged by this preview delivery.
